neighbours.label: the stem token of a word for majority or minority when the tokenizer splits it (' major|ities', '-major|ity', ' больш|инство', ' мень|шинство'), as against the whole-token words ' majority' / ' minority' and other senses of 'major'
fire: The constitution was designed to restrain powerful majorities in parliament.
The bill passed easily in the Republican-majority Senate last spring.
Refugees fled to several Muslim-majority countries in the region.
Опрос показал, что большинство жителей города против нового моста.
Закон должен защищать права национальных меньшинств в стране.
In both chambers the party now holds comfortable majorities after the vote.
Многие избиратели поддержали кандидата, и он получил большинство голосов.
The governor faces a hostile Democratic-majority legislature next year.
quiet: The constitution was designed to restrain powerful majority leaders in parliament.
The bill passed easily with a majority in the Senate last spring.
Refugees fled to several minority communities in the region.
Опрос показал, что жители города против нового моста.
The law must protect the rights of national minorities in the country.
In both chambers the party now holds a major advantage after the vote.
The new highway will be a major road through the northern suburbs.
The governor faces a hostile legislature controlled by the minority party next year.
